concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-unified-commerce-pay-by-link-supported-payment-methods]] — 2026-09-15 Pay by Link Customer Area/API method matrix requiring merchant-account addition, with wallet prerequisites, ACH Direct Debit warning, and unresolved BNPL conflict against the Customer Area creation guide (page metadata last modified 2024-06-11).
warnings: The matrix marks Affirm, Alma and Atome for Customer Area, but the separately ingested Customer Area creation guide says buy now, pay later methods are excluded; do not collapse this into an eligibility guarantee.
